{{Otheruses|Scorpion}}
The '''''Scorpion''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] that was owned and operated by a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who attempted an assault on a group of [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], designated ''[[Qiluiy]]'', which was escorting the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] group ''[[Xroi]]'' in the [[Mennaalii system]]. The pirates in question possessed several starfighters typically operated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], attacking with several squads of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], [[A-wing starfighter/Legends|A-wing]]s, and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]]. The Alliance quickly deployed a responsive force led by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] to rush to the convoy's aid and to drive off the ''Scorpion''. The assault was quickly thwarted, resulting in the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] and her squadrons being destroyed.
